scope: Fresh automated PCI QEMU runtime acceptance of Talons on the current ARM64 ISO. The probe verified terrain rendering, visible flight-frame changes after Right and Up input, Escape cleanup, terminal recovery (`40+2;` returned 42), and `zstatus failed=0`. UTM and Pi hardware are not covered.
arm64_adaptations: The bundled Talons source uses a 64x64 map and proportionally reduced initial speed to keep its terrain generation practical on the ARM64 target while preserving the stock map-to-speed ratio. The single-vCPU path runs panel generation synchronously. Parentheses were added around center-coordinate shifts and fixed-point 1<<16 divisors to preserve intended arithmetic.
